## Usage (from `packages/core/stories/forms/DzInplace.stories.ts`, story `TextField`)

```vue

      <div class="p-8 max-w-sm">
        <label class="block text-sm font-medium mb-1 text-[var(--dz-foreground)]">Full name</label>
        <DzInplace v-bind="args" v-model:value="value" placeholder="Enter a name" />
        <p class="text-xs mt-3 text-[var(--dz-muted-foreground)]">Current value: {{ value }}</p>
      </div>
    
```

**Why this pattern:** A display-to-edit toggle: the trigger is replaced by the editor it opens, so focus has to move into and back out of a node that did not exist a tick earlier. APG covers neither half of that.
